context:
Standardize on the currently used orchestration path (`BenchmarkOrchestrator`
delegating to `run_benchmark_lifecycle`) as the canonical execution engine.
Move metadata enrichment and export decisions into shared helpers invoked by
that canonical path, then collapse run-command branches to use one shared
execute-and-export routine.

For alpha, prioritize simplification over compatibility shims: make
`ExecutionPipeline` explicitly non-runtime (or remove runtime-facing usage),
and move all behavior-critical logic to the canonical path. Do not preserve
dual-runtime behavior just for backward compatibility.
description:
The benchmark run entrypoint currently has multiple execution branches in
`benchbox/cli/commands/run.py` and two orchestration architectures in the CLI
layer (`BenchmarkOrchestrator` + `run_benchmark_lifecycle` vs `ExecutionPipeline`).

In current real CLI execution, `run.py` routes through `BenchmarkOrchestrator`
and `run_benchmark_lifecycle`, not `ExecutionPipeline`. This means behavior and
metadata added only in `benchbox/cli/execution_pipeline.py` can be absent in
real exported artifacts.

This TODO converts architecture review findings into a concrete refactor plan
that reduces accidental complexity by:
- Selecting and enforcing one canonical benchmark execution path
- Unifying export behavior across direct, load/data-only, and interactive flows
- Relocating metadata enrichment to the canonical path so artifacts are consistent
- Removing or deprecating dead/legacy branches and compatibility shims
- Adding parity tests to prevent branch drift regressions

anti_patterns.dont: duplicate export blocks in each `run.py` branch
anti_patterns.instead: centralize export path selection, filename assignment, and format handling in one helper.
consolidate around one runtime path and reduce adapters/wrappers.

anti_patterns.dont: keep dead legacy shims (`quick`, `no_regenerate`-style branch logic) solely for compatibility
anti_patterns.instead: remove or hard-fail obsolete paths with clear release notes.
anti_patterns.why: this is alpha and complexity cost is higher

anti_patterns.instead: move metadata wiring into shared canonical execution/export code.
anti_patterns.why: that path is not the default runtime

preserves.behavior: Data-only and load-only flows remain supported with correct phase semantics.
Default CLI behavior and UX remain stable for existing `benchbox run` usage.
Dry-run behavior remains fully functional and separate from live execution.
